generate_gmock_classes_from_header: run gmock_class.py on a C++ header file to generate Google Mock classes for all classes to stdout
generate_gmock_for_specific_class: run gmock_class.py on a header file with a class name argument to generate a mock for that specific class
generate_mock_with_custom_indent: run gmock_class.py with the INDENT environment variable set to control output indentation width
review_GenerateMethods_virtual_function_: review the _GenerateMethods function that extracts virtual functions from a class AST node and emits MOCK_METHOD macros
review_GenerateMocks_class_iteration: review the _GenerateMocks function that iterates over AST nodes to produce Mock class definitions with namespace and template support
